steps: This video shows how M C P lets one agent discover tools from different servers. Your code lists two servers, fs over standard input and output and crm over H T T P, and the S D K acts as the client.
The client spawns fs as a local subprocess and asks for tools list over J S O N R P C. It gets back read file, and fs is connected. Servers can offer tools, resources and prompts.
It also connects to the remote crm server over H T T P, runs the same discovery, and finds lookup customer. Same protocol, different transport.
Discovered tools are named m c p, server, tool, like m c p crm lookup customer. Allowed tools decides which ones Claude may use, and both are passed to Claude with the prompt.
Claude reads look up customer C seventy seven, and returns a tool use with the full namespaced tool name and the customer id.
The client routes that call to crm as tools call over H T T P, and crm returns the record: Globex, gold tier.
The record goes back as a tool result, and Claude answers in one turn, grounded in real data. One protocol, no per tool glue code. The full walkthrough is in the Gennoor Claude certification course.
